artifacts.summary: Review of the merged proof mode and its 14 filed tasks, with a logical-vs-sequencing edge analysis, ten development dimensions, and a proposed milestone outline for records/proof-mode.md.

memory_candidates.content: The /roadmap agent (roadmap-agent.md) builds its picture only from specs/state.json (roadmap_batches, roadmap_notes, open tasks) and the generate-task-order.sh wave table. It reads no goals or planning document unless the quoted instruction names one, and its write contract covers adding dependency edges (edge_only --depends-on-add) but describes no edge removal. A planning document therefore influences the roadmap only through tasks filed from it or an explicit /roadmap "<instruction>" naming it.

BimodalLogic's research/ directory is gitignored (.gitignore /research/), so research/NEW_DIRECTIONS.md -- cited as the source by every proof-mode task record -- is local-only and not a durable anchor for tracked deliverables. Its stated count of 22 proof-mode tactics is off by one against the tree (21 syntax declarations under FormalSystem/Automation/ProofMode/).
